ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a cylinder; inside the top circular base there is a line segment pointing from inside the circle to the right edge, labeled r = 3, indicating that the radius is 3; the vertical direction on the right side of the cylinder is labeled h, indicating the height. method.method_draft: Inspect the image first: the cylinder has a circular top base with radius 3, and the unknown vertical height is h. From the text, take the volume as 45π cubic centimeters. Compute the area of one circular base from the visual radius: A = π·3^2 = 9π square cm. Interpret the cylinder as stacking identical circular slices of area 9π; height equals total volume divided by base area. Thus h = 45π ÷ 9π = 5 centimeters.
